body.objective: Derive the exact Fourier-n/SU(2) finite vector block pencil A_jmn(t)=F_jmn+t W for the scalar-flat Berger datum M=S1_(2pi) x SU(2), g=dtheta^2+sigma1^2+sigma2^2+4sigma3^2, and from it the true normalized coupled Schur blocks S_L,jmn(t)=(2/3)I+(1/3)delta A_jmn(t)^(-1)d. Supply self-adjoint domains, scalar/vector priming, every matched zero-pole factor, exact block projectors and uniform high-mode resolvent bounds. The scalar one-inverse surrogate I+(t/3)Delta_0^(-1)delta W d is forbidden because it has the wrong principal symbol and first representation block.
body.stop_condition: A content-addressed exact block theorem gives A_jmn(t), d_jmn, delta_jmn and S_L,jmn(t) for every Fourier/SU(2) label, proves the common primed domain and self-adjoint/Agmon-ray disposition, enumerates all zero and matched zero-pole strata, and proves uniform high-mode estimates sufficient to define the requested resolvent carrier; or proves the first exact vector-block/domain obstruction and names the next strictly smaller theorem.
body.forbid: No scalar one-inverse surrogate; no local Wodzicki or heat-kernel row substituted for the finite resolvent; no floating spectrum without certified intervals and exact domain provenance; no special-background interpolation; no Lorentzian Green carrier; no finite five-function, QME, Hadamard, particle, positivity or unitarity promotion.
notes: The exact scalar blocks are Delta_0=n^2+j(j+1)-(3/4)m^2 and delta W d=2j(j+1)-3m^2, with left multiplicity 2j+1.
The normalized Schur correction begins at pseudodifferential order -2. Its first variation is -(1/3)Delta_0^(-1)delta W d Delta_0^(-1), not +(1/3)Delta_0^(-1)delta W d.
The j=1/2, |m|=1/2, n=0 block distinguishes the two derivatives exactly: -64/81 versus 4/9.
Exact and interval-numeric objects must remain different types, and the independent verifier must construct its representation matrices without importing producer verdicts.
